name: Create a microfrontends group with applications
description: Create a microfrontends group with applications Creates a microfrontends group and attaches multiple projects in a single request. POST /v1/microfrontends/group

POST /v1/microfrontends/group

Optional: teamId (query) — The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.; slug (query) — The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.; body (body)
